ilo_conventions.title: Hours of Work (Industry) Convention, 1919
key_requirements: Working hours shall not exceed 8 hours per day and 48 hours per week
Overtime shall not exceed limits set by national regulation, generally recommended maximum of 12 hours per week
Overtime must be voluntary and compensated at a premium rate of at least 125% of normal wage
Workers must have a minimum rest period of 24 consecutive hours per week
ilo_conventions.maximum_overtime_monthly: Recommended not to exceed 40 hours per month as per ILO guidelines
ilo_conventions.rest_requirements: Minimum 11 consecutive hours rest between shifts

ilo_conventions.title: Weekly Rest (Industry) Convention, 1921
key_requirements: Every worker shall enjoy a period of rest comprising at least 24 consecutive hours in every period of 7 days
The weekly rest period shall, wherever possible, coincide with the day recognized as rest day by tradition or custom
Exceptions may be made for force majeure or urgent work

ilo_conventions.title: Forced Labour Convention, 1930
key_requirements: No forced or compulsory labour shall be exacted
Overtime must be genuinely voluntary
Workers must not be penalized for refusing overtime beyond legal limits
Non-compete clauses without compensation may constitute restriction on freedom to work

ilo_conventions.title: Protection of Wages Convention, 1949
key_requirements: Wages shall be paid regularly and in full
Deductions from wages shall be limited and regulated
Workers shall be informed of wage conditions before employment
Probation wages shall not be unreasonably below standard rates

ilo_conventions.title: Discrimination (Employment and Occupation) Convention, 1958
key_requirements: No discrimination in terms of employment based on race, sex, religion, political opinion, national extraction, or social origin
Equal remuneration for work of equal value
Notice periods should be equal for employer and employee

ilo_conventions.title: Termination of Employment Convention, 1982
key_requirements: Employment shall not be terminated without valid reason
Worker must be given opportunity to defend against charges before dismissal
Adequate notice period must be provided
Severance pay shall be provided upon termination
Disciplinary dismissal requires due process and progressive discipline

ilo_conventions.title: Maternity Protection Convention, 2000
key_requirements: Maternity leave of not less than 14 weeks
Cash benefits during maternity leave at no less than two-thirds of previous earnings
Employment protection during pregnancy and maternity leave

ilo_conventions.title: Employment Relationship Recommendation, 2006
key_requirements: Clear documentation of employment terms
Probation periods must be reasonable and clearly defined
Maximum probation period should not exceed 6 months for highly skilled positions
Probation period should be proportional to the nature of the job

general_principles.freedom_of_association: Workers have the right to form and join organizations of their choosing
general_principles.collective_bargaining: Workers have the right to bargain collectively
general_principles.elimination_of_forced_labor: All forms of forced or compulsory labor must be eliminated
general_principles.elimination_of_discrimination: Elimination of discrimination in employment and occupation
